moves.text: Rahu moves from Kumbha into Makara.
moves.until_text: Rahu stays in Makara until 24 June 2028, when it moves into Dhanu.

moves.text: Ketu moves from Simha into Kataka.
moves.until_text: Ketu stays in Kataka until 24 June 2028, when it moves into Mithuna.

moves.text: Rahu leaves your 2nd house and enters your 1st house.
moves.from_theme: The 2nd house is about family, speech and savings.
moves.to_theme: The 1st house is about yourself and how you begin things.

moves.text: Ketu leaves your 8th house and enters your 7th house.
moves.from_theme: The 8th house is about change and things shared with others.
moves.to_theme: The 7th house is about partnership and marriage.

others.text: Saturn stays in Meena, your 3rd house.
Jupiter stays in Simha, your 8th house.
